overview_description.description:
AIMon empowers Fortune 200 enterprises to build deterministic and dependable Generative AI applications. The platform continuously monitors your apps to detect critical issues such as hallucinations, instruction deviation, and poor RAG retrieval, while also generating high-quality, targeted datasets that accelerate model improvement.

With benchmark-leading accuracy, AIMon closes the loop between detection and optimization to help you deliver AI that performs exactly as intended.

product.name: RRE-1 (Retrieval Relevance Evaluator and Re-ranking Model)
product.description: A domain-adaptable model for evaluating and improving retrieval relevance in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems, available via a low-latency API for re-ranking and evaluation.
